documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ELANTAS Beck India reported strong financial performance for the year ended 31st December 2025, driven by revenue growth of 13.27 percent and increased margins compared to the previous year. The company completed the integration of Von Roll resin operations in India and progressed on establishing a new manufacturing facility in Gujarat. Management highlighted continued focus on innovation, operational safety, and sustainability initiatives aligned with the ALTANA group's climate goals. The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 7.50 per equity share for the financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the markets served by the company continue to show strong long-term potential.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the markets served by ELANTAS continue to show strong long-term potential.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, and is obtaining requisite governmental approvals.
capex_expansion.quote: Your Company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, and is currently in the process of obtaining the requisite governmental approvals.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure incurred during the year ended 31st December 2025 aggregated to Rs. 3,087.84 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure incurred during the year ended 31st December, 2025 aggregated to ₹ 3,087.84 Lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of Rs. 7.50 per equity share of Rs. 10 each for the year ended 31st December 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of ₹ 7.50/- per equity share of ₹ 10/- each, subject to the deduction of tax as applicable, for the year ended 31st December, 2025 (previous year ₹ 7.50/- per equity share).

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend payout, if approved by members, will be Rs. 594.58 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend pay-out, if approved by the Members in the ensuing AGM, will be ₹ 594.58 Lakhs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the year 2025 unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year 2025 unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
